en.name: Slingshot Siege
en.desc: Launch birds from a slingshot to topple targets and structures!
en.description: Slingshot Siege is an original physics puzzle where you launch colorful birds from a slingshot to topple targets and structures. Use trajectory, momentum, and strategy to create chain reactions. Wood, stone, and glass obstacles each respond differently to impact.
en.objectives: Clear every target with a limited flock. Maximize destruction for bonus points and complete each level efficiently.
en.howToPlay: Click or drag on the slingshot to aim, then release to launch. Hit targets and structures to deal damage. Clear every target to complete the level.

rules.controls: Click and drag on the slingshot to aim. Release to launch the bird. The further you pull, the more power.
mechanics: You have a limited number of birds per level
Targets are cleared when hit with enough force
Level ends when all targets are cleared or birds run out

tips: Aim for weak points in structures
Use the trajectory preview to plan your shot
Wood blocks are easiest to destroy
Stone blocks require more force to break

faq.question: How do I aim the bird?
faq.answer: Click and drag backwards on the slingshot. The further you pull, the more power. Release to launch!

faq.question: What happens if I run out of birds?
faq.answer: The level ends and you can retry. Try to use fewer birds for better scores!

faq.question: How do I get more points?
faq.answer: Destroy more blocks, use fewer birds, and cause chain reactions for bonus destruction.

zh.name: 弹弓攻城
zh.desc: 用弹弓发射小鸟，击倒目标和建筑！
zh.description: 弹弓攻城是一款原创物理益智游戏。你从弹弓发射彩色小鸟，击倒目标和结构物。利用轨迹、动量和策略制造连锁反应；木头、石头和玻璃障碍对撞击的反应各不相同。
zh.objectives: 在有限的小鸟数量内清除所有目标。最大化破坏获得额外分数，并高效完成关卡。
zh.howToPlay: 点击或拖动弹弓来瞄准，释放后发射。撞击目标和建筑造成伤害，清除所有目标即可完成关卡。

rules.controls: 点击并拖动弹弓来瞄准。释放发射小鸟。拉得越远，力量越大。
mechanics: 受到足够力量撞击时目标会被清除
不同材料有不同耐久度
清除所有目标或鸟用完时关卡结束

tips: 使用轨迹预览来计划射击
石块需要更强力量才能打破

faq.question: 如何瞄准小鸟？
faq.answer: 点击并向后拖动弹弓。拉得越远，力量越大。释放发射！

faq.question: 鸟用完了会怎样？
faq.answer: 关卡结束，可以重试。尝试用更少的鸟获得更好分数！

faq.question: 如何获得更多分数？
faq.answer: 摧毁更多方块，使用更少的鸟，引发连锁反应获得额外破坏。
